messages:
sam_sales: Heads-up 11 Cadence Music wants a POC. New vendor model: cadence-mel-13b. Requirements: private deployment (VPC), KMS, low-latency embeddings, and a hallucination-reduced variant. can we run a compatibility sweep and a short perf report by Friday?
neha_engineering: Yep. Need to know if vendor supplied quantized weights or if we must quantize in-house. also confirm typical sequence lengths and peak embed QPS.
ryan_se: Vendor says they can provide int8 and q4 weights. Seq len usually 1k, but some scoring jobs hit 2k. embedding QPS expected ~300 steady, 800 bursts. KMS must be customer-managed.
mira_solutions: Contract-wise they need SOC2 evidence and an NDA. also curious on pricing for dedicated + kms + 90d audit log retention. billing_bot: any rough uplift?
billing_bot: Estimate: dedicated base +25% over hosted. KMS & long retention add fixed monthly fees; I'll DM a line-item.
neha_engineering: Plan: run variant sweep (float32 / int8 / q4_0), KV-cache validation for 1k/2k, and an embedding throughput soak on a 4xA10 pool. I'll post perf summary.
sam_sales: Demo scheduled Tue; Friday EOD go/no-go needed. can ops confirm VPC peering and key policy requirements?
infra_ops: VPC peering + private endpoint fine. For cross-account KMS decrypt we need their KMS ARN and a key policy. Recommend reserving burst lanes for embeddings.
ryan_se: Security flags in the questionnaire: data deletion assurance, export controls, and encryption in transit details. tagging sec_bot.
sec_bot: Auto-report: SOC2 status: in progress; KMS: supported; encryption: TLS1.3 on egress + in-cluster mTLS. Please attach KMS ARN and signed data processing addendum.
neha_engineering: Early perf notes: q4_0 reduces memory ~45% and gives ~12ms extra per token vs float32. int8 shows faster latency but slight logits drift on some safety-sensitive prompts. Will try reranker fallback for hallucination-sensitive flows.
mira_solutions: Can we set fallback routing to a smaller but more deterministic variant on latency spikes? client wants deterministic behavior.
neha_engineering: Yes. Routing policy: primary cadence-mel-13b-int8, fallback cadence-mel-7b-slim. Canary rollout + autoscale thresholds will be configured.
sam_sales: Any blockers preventing demo? quick bullets please. :eyes:
ryan_se: Legal needs MOU for data deletion and NDA signed 1 blocker until signed. Need KMS ARN.
billing_bot: Pricing OK to present as draft; final SOW required.
mira_solutions: I'll push legal and ask client about hybrid dedicated-hosted while SOC2 docs finalize.
neha_engineering: No infra/perf blockers yet. Will run final embedding soak tomorrow and share numbers.
sam_sales: Next steps: neha run final tests, ryan request KMS ARN + legal MOU, mira chase SOC2/NDA, billing prepare estimate. I'll assemble a one-pager for Cadence. Thanks! :thumbsup:
